fact_text: The Sukkur-Khairpur region accounts for about 40 percent of Pakistan's national date output, according to the reporter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Pakistan produces about 600,000 tons of dates a year, and the reporter said the country is counted among the world's top six date producers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Pakistan grows more than 300 date varieties, and Aseel, Karbala and Dakki are among the named types, with Aseel described as the highest quality.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: After cooking for about 15 to 20 minutes, dates are sun-dried for roughly six days until they are fully dry, per the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Pakistani dates struggle in international markets because producers lack the processing capacity to make date powder, paste and syrup, according to the exporters the video cites.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Exporters said about 50 percent of fruit is wasted after picking from the tree because handling and storage facilities are inadequate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: The FY22 date exports were valued at about 53 million, with the currency not stated in the transcript, per the Trade Development Authority cited in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Major buyers of Pakistani dates include the United Kingdom, Germany and the United States.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Date pulp (chhara) was selling at about Rs 8,000 per maund in July 2025, per the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Date seeds, which are sold for making supari, were priced at about Rs 800 per kg in July 2025, per the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)

fact_text: Processors use a colouring chemical imported from China to keep dates yellow, according to the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Pakistan’s Khajoor Season: 600,000 Tons, 300 Varieties and a Global Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-23)
